title: Quantifying Cultural-Psychological Constructs in Four Centuries of Ottoman Court Registers
abstract: arXiv:2611.24981v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Populations vary along cultural dimensions such as individualism, collectivism, and honor. But how can these dimensions be studied in historical societies for which conventional psychological data are unavailable? Here, we introduce a computational text-analytic framework for quantifying psychological constructs in 54,670 Ottoman Turkish court records from 21 Istanbul courts spanning 1513-1911 CE. We develop sentence-embedding models adapted to Ottoman legal language and extend a theory-driven, text-analytic pipeline to capture cultural variation along the dimensions of individualism, collectivism, and honor in this historical corpus. We evaluate our models through multiple methods: document retrieval, semantic textual similarity, questionnaire-item classification, and validation against expert annotations. translated_title: 量化四个世纪奥斯曼法庭登记册中的文化心理学构念
translated_abstract: 人群在个人主义、集体主义和荣誉等文化维度上存在差异。但对于缺乏常规心理学数据的历史社会，如何研究这些维度呢？本文提出了一个计算文本分析框架，用于量化公元1513年至1911年间伊斯坦布尔21个法庭的54,670份奥斯曼土耳其语法庭记录中的心理学构念。我们开发了适配奥斯曼法律语言的句子嵌入模型，并扩展了一个理论驱动的文本分析流程，以捕捉这一历史语料库中个人主义、集体主义和荣誉维度上的文化变异。我们通过多种方法对模型进行评估：文档检索、语义文本相似度、问卷条目分类以及与专家标注的对比验证。我们微调的句子Transformer模型（OTA-BERTurk）在文档检索测试集上取得了0.843的Recall@1，以及平均倒数……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一个计算文本分析框架，通过适配奥斯曼法律语言的句子嵌入模型（OTA-BERTurk），对近四个世纪（1513-1911年）的54,670份伊斯坦布尔法庭记录进行量化分析，成功在历史语料中捕捉个人主义、集体主义和荣誉等文化心理维度的变异。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a computational text-analytic framework with an adapted sentence-embedding model (OTA-BERTurk) to quantify cultural-psychological constructs—individualism, collectivism, and honor—across 54,670 Ottoman court records spanning four centuries (1513-1911).
